name: Rust Fix — Environment & Build Config
description: Fix build configuration issues: incorrect Cargo.toml settings, broken build scripts, wrong edition, missing binaries.

tasks.description: A Cargo project 'old_app' uses an invalid edition in Cargo.toml. Fix the edition to a valid one (2021) so 'cargo check' succeeds.
tasks.expected_outcome: cargo check succeeds in old_app directory

tasks.description: A Cargo project 'cli_tool' has the [[bin]] section pointing to a nonexistent source file. Create the file or fix the path so 'cargo check' succeeds.
tasks.expected_outcome: cargo check succeeds in cli_tool directory

tasks.description: A Cargo project 'with_build' has a build.rs that doesn't compile. Fix the build script so 'cargo check' succeeds.
tasks.expected_outcome: cargo check succeeds in with_build directory
